The game engine crossed the aisle into brand work

The same real time tools that build blockbuster games are quietly building activations, films and live shows. And the gaming world just sold out its biggest room.

01 Field notes

Gamescom sold out for the first time

Gamescom 2026 reached full exhibition capacity for the first time ever, with organizers already planning to expand the format. It runs late August in Cologne and is expected to surpass every previous edition. Even payment brands are showing up, sponsoring the cosplay village.

In the lab

The engine that pays creators a billion

Epic teased Unreal Engine 6 and confirmed it has paid creators over 1 billion dollars through Unreal Editor for Fortnite, with iteration times down about 40 percent. The engine behind the games is the same one behind virtual production and live visuals.

Real time is one skill, many outputs

A team fluent in a real time engine can ship a game level, an LED volume backdrop, an AR layer and a projection show from the same toolset. The wall between games and experiences is mostly gone.
